2014_subclasses.swarmkeeper.description: Swarmkeepers are rangers who have learned to call upon the power of nature's smallest creatures. They can summon a swarm of fey spirits that take the form of various creatures, and they use the swarm to aid them in battle.
2014_subclasses.swarmkeeper.swarmkeeper-:
At 3rd level, you learn the mage hand cantrip if you don't already know it. When you cast it, the hand takes the form of a swarm of nature spirits. In addition, you learn an additional spell when you reach certain levels in this class, as shown in the Swarmkeeper Spells table. The spell counts as a ranger spell for you, but it doesn't count against the number of ranger spells you know.

3rd: faerie fire
5th: web
9th: gaseous form
13th: giant insect
17th: insect plague
The spell counts as a ranger spell for you, but it doesn't count against the number of ranger spells you know.
2014_subclasses.swarmkeeper.gathered-swa:
At 3rd level, you can call forth a swarm of fey spirits to attack your enemies. As a bonus action, you can conjure the swarm in a space you can see within 30 feet of you. The swarm is a spectral version of a Tiny beast (bats, insects, birds, or other creatures of your choice). The swarm occupies its space and doesn't provoke opportunity attacks. The swarm remains for 1 minute, until you dismiss it as a bonus action, or until you use this feature again.

When you conjure the swarm, you can choose one of the following effects:

Damage: Once per turn when you hit a creature with a weapon attack, you can have the swarm deal 1d6 piercing, slashing, or bludgeoning damage (your choice) to the target.

Movement: You can use a bonus action to move the swarm up to 30 feet. If the swarm moves through a creature's space, that creature takes 1 piercing damage. You can also move a willing creature within 5 feet of the swarm up to 10 feet.

Protection: When a creature you can see takes damage while within 5 feet of the swarm, you can use your reaction to reduce the damage by 1d6.

The damage increases to 2d6 at 11th level.

2014_subclasses.swarmkeeper.writhing-tid: At 7th level, you can call on the swarm to lift you up. As a bonus action, you gain a flying speed of 10 feet. This speed lasts for 1 minute or until you are incapacitated. You can use this feature a number of times equal to your proficiency bonus, and you regain all expended uses when you finish a long rest.
As a bonus action, gain a flying speed of 10 feet for 1 minute or until incapacitated. Usable a number of times equal to your proficiency bonus, regaining all uses on a long rest.
2014_subclasses.swarmkeeper.mighty-swarm:
At 11th level, your Gathered Swarm grows more powerful. When you use Gathered Swarm, you can choose one of the following additional benefits:

Damage: The swarm's damage increases by 1d6.

Movement: The swarm's movement speed increases by10 feet, and the creature moved takes 1d6 damage.

Protection: The damage reduction increases by 1d6.

2014_subclasses.swarmkeeper.swarming-dis: At 15th level, you can call on the swarm to protect you from harm. When you take damage, you can use your reaction to give yourself resistance to that damage type until the end of the current turn. The swarm then teleports to an unoccupied space of your choice that you can see within 30 feet of you.
The swarm then teleports to an unoccupied space of your choice that you can see within 30 feet of you. (reaction).
